title: All Code Is Slop (Except Mine) — Lauren Tan, SpaceXSI
description:
11,000 pull requests in one month, with a revert rate around 0.5%. Lauren Tan (poteto) shares how the Grok Bot team at SpaceXSI scales AI coding agents through software architecture, lint rules, automated testing, runtime verification and formal verification with TLA+ and Lean. See how Cursor agents and pstack turn these software engineering foundations into reliable software factories.
